prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: production RGBA PNG overlay for an instant-camera app, one isolated empty photographic paper frame.
Primary request: beautiful tactile photorealistic photograph border, professionally scanned flat material, perfectly frontal orthographic view with absolutely no perspective or rotation.
Composition: one square outer frame centered on a square 1024x1024 canvas. Outer frame edges near x=24 and x=1000, y=24 and y=1000. A large empty rectangular cutout window with straight edges near x=88 to x=936, y=88 to y=848. Side and top borders are narrow; bottom paper border is about twice as thick. Leave all four corners and the entire frame visible.
Transparency: genuinely transparent alpha background outside the frame AND a genuinely transparent alpha cutout throughout the large center window. Nothing inside the window. No fake checkerboard, no black or colored fill, no photograph. Clean antialiased edges, tiny material shadows confined to frame edges, no cast shadow on a background.
Style: subtle realistic material detail that stays elegant at small display sizes. Reusable stretchable frame texture with clean continuous edge strips.
Text: no text, letters, numbers, branding, watermark or symbols.
Avoid: mockup scenes, hands, objects, multiple frames, montage, heavy decoration, gradients in the empty aperture, diagonal edges, exaggerated distressed grime.
Material: refined warm-white instant photographic paper, fine satin micrograin, delicate embossed inner lip, softly rounded outer corners, immaculate gallery quality, understated raised paper edge. No blue or gray cast.
